description: This file defines an abstract PHP class 'Smarty_Internal_CompileBase' that provides common functionalities for internal compile plugins within the Smarty template engine. It manages attribute validation, tag stack operations, and related utilities used during template compilation.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_CompileBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing foundational methods for internal Smarty compile plugins, including attribute processing and tag stack management.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Validates and maps attributes passed to a Smarty tag against required and optional attribute lists, handling shorthand and option flags, and checking for errors.

methods.name: openTag
methods.description: Pushes an opening tag name and optional data onto the compiler's tag stack.

methods.name: closeTag
methods.description: Pops the most recent tag from the stack and verifies it matches the expected opening tag, returning either the tag name or associated data.
